title: Borrowing Nonconcurrent Controls for RMST Contrasts in Platform Trials with Enrollment Cusps
banked_reason: D0.5.G: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < ceiling_for_field 7.4; tier=subfield; salvageable=false within the fixed-center compact-support scope.
gap_reasons: The delivered phase diagram concerns exact fixed-center tangent fibers; critical center-free all-control attainment relies on exact compact support, which makes almost all exterior controls an undisturbed reference.

Critical concurrent optimal refinements require supplied H00, and the centering obstruction establishes failure of experiment reconstruction rather than the unknown-center minimax risk or honest-length benchmark for the causal contrast.

The sole numerical strict-gain certificate uses kappa=10^-4 near the regular-density limit, while the convergent programs provide no solved optimal values or demonstrated practical computational costs, limiting the projected leading-econometrics score to 6.5.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a fixed-center cusp/window phase diagram, a critical strict-gain region for both risk and connected honest interval length, finite decision-value approximations, and the R=lambda/2 equality face. Two attempts to solve the full critical equality frontier only restated unknown value gaps; that question remains open. The math review passed, but the general reviewer rated the sound, compact-support result subfield, below the field floor.
tldr: For an enrollment cusp of order \(\kappa>0\), the threshold \(\gamma=1/(\kappa+3)\) separates fixed-center causal RMST borrowing problems. Concurrent and all-control Gaussian values agree below the threshold and differ above it by a positive control-information contribution. At the threshold, convergent finite programs describe all four full-class values; explicit upper and lower certificates give simultaneous strict risk and honest-length gains on a nonempty open region, with equality on \(R=\lambda/2\). Critical all-control refinements admit unknown-center record implementations through a root-\(n\) exterior control reference. Critical concurrent refinements require supplied \(H_{00}\); a coefficient pilot alone cannot reconstruct their centered scores. Supercritical record attainment remains fully center-free.
